detail.title: Long Page
detail.markdown:
## Metadata beside the text

This page's text is taller than its metadata, so the metadata sits in a **180 pt column** beside it. Nothing in the data chooses this: Wicket measures both.

### What a page can hold

- Headings, *emphasis* and `code`
- Lists, like this one
- [Links](https://www.apple.com/macos/), which open in the browser

```
wicket check ~/Library/Application\ Support/Wicket/Extensions/gallery
```

> Block quotes, for what someone said.

| Screen | Selectable | Sized by |
|---|---|---|
| answer | yes | one large row |
| list | rows | its rows |
| detail | no | its text |

Return on a page runs its first action; this one has none, so Return copies the text.
